title: VIO powers
question: What does Lagos State Traffic Law 2012 section 12 say about vio powers?
shortAnswer: Lagos State Traffic Law 2012 s.12 — VIO may stop vehicles, inspect documents, check roadworthiness, arrest offenders.
legalExplanation:
**Section 12 of the Lagos State Traffic Law 2012** provides:

VIO may stop vehicles, inspect documents, check roadworthiness, arrest offenders

This provision empowers Lagos State Traffic Law 2012 officers with specific powers and duties.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Know your rights. Ask for identification. Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Document everything.
whatToAvoid: Do not run, bribe, resist, destroy evidence, or sign without lawyer.
whatToDocument: Officer name, agency, badge, vehicle, time, location, witnesses, injuries, photos/video.
whatToDoAfter: Get lawyer. File complaint with agency complaints unit or ICPC/PCR. Demand court within 24h. Document injuries.
